[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make dev-install SASE updates fast[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `,U` on a dev (editable) SASE install completes in seconds[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of minutes, with every existing safety check, blocker, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]fallback, journal record, toast, and restart behavior preserved.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]fast_dev_update.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/fast_dev_update.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-i9[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-i9/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Instrument dev-update step durations[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]timings[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]timings: record per-command and per-step wall-clock durations in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dev-update journal, surface the slowest steps in the result log, and add[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a read-only analysis script so every later phase has a hard before/after[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]baseline.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Build the Rust core and LSP in one feature-unified cargo [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]invocation[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]unified-build[dim] · [dim][/dim]after timings[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]unified-build: collapse the two separate cargo/maturin reconcile steps [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into a single feature-unified build so sase_core and its shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dependencies compile once per update instead of twice, and so the two [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]builds stop invalidating each other's cached units.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add a fast dev-update cargo profile[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]fast-profile[dim] · [dim][/dim]after unified-build[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fast-profile: add a dev-update-only cargo profile in sase-core that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drops LTO and codegen-units=1 in favor of incremental parallel codegen, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wire the dev-update recipes to it with an escape hatch, and prove the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]published wheel/CI profile is untouched and runtime performance does not[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regress.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Prebuild Rust artifacts off the interactive path[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]prebuild[dim] · [dim][/dim]after unified-build, fast-profile[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prebuild: build the Rust artifacts in the background from a dedicated [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mirror clone as soon as the update poller sees incoming sase-core [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commits, then install the stamped prebuilt artifacts during the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]interactive update when every provenance field matches, falling back to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a normal build on any mismatch.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end verification and documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after timings, unified-build, fast-profile, prebuild[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: measure the real `,U` flow against the phase-one baseline, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-exercise every preserved blocker/fallback/restart path on the live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dev install, confirm `just install` and CI are unaffected, and refresh [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the Rust backend docs.[/#D7D7AF]
